slides.title: Light that becomes language
slides.body: Step out of your everyday screen and into a world of light. The Glyph Matrix brings your phone to life with functional and playful animations, turning intelligence into pure entertainment.

slides.title: The Glyph Matrix
slides.body: At the heart of Glyph Interface, the Glyph Matrix displays notifications and much more. From important alerts to functions and games, it’s more than light. It’s where a new experience begins. Highlight features: Camera: A visual countdown when using the timer. Torch: A powerful burst of light using all 489 micro-LEDs for an instant, bright light. Volume: A visualisation of current volume levels. NFC: An animation comes to life when NFC is triggered.

slides.title: The Button
slides.body: Tap to cycle through all Glyph Toys and long-press to select one, whether it's a handy utility or a fun game.

slides.title: Glyph notifications
slides.body: A world of interactions. For the first time, Glyph Interface goes beyond lights with rich notifications, combining visuals and sounds for meaningful updates. A sound and light show Transform everyday notifications and calls into vibrant, unique visuals. It’s no longer just light and sound; it's a new layer of communication between you and your phone. Less distractions, more intention Stay focused while remaining accessible to what matters most. Relevant information from your contacts or apps will light up the display with generative visuals, ringtones and vibrations. Each caller gets assigned to a unique combination of visuals and sound, and you can configure custom rules to personalise notifications even more. * CallerID coming soon

slides.title: Notifications that really matter to you
slides.body: Illuminate what matters. With Essential Notifications, assign persistent icons on the Glyph Matrix for unread notifications from specific contacts, apps, and keywords.

slides.title: Glyph Toys
slides.body: A collection of micro-experiences that bring your phone to life. Tap the Glyph Button to switch between utilities, ambient interactions, and games. Glyph mirror Capture every moment, effortlessly. Perfectly frame selfies with a live preview displayed on Glyph Matrix. Spin the bottle Take your chance with a fun reinterpretation of the spin the bottle game, excitement guaranteed. Rock paper scissors The classic showdown. Choose your weapon and let fate decide the winner. Digital clock Check time in classic 90s digital style, 12-hour or 24-hour formats. And many more to come.

slides.title: Your second memory
slides.body: Capture content, inspirations and thoughts with the Essential Key. Essential Space automatically organises and catalogs everything for you, generating personalised suggestions, summaries or action points. All with a little help from AI. In control of your data All your content is securely stored locally on your device. When we send your captured content to the cloud for secure processing, your data is encrypted and automatically deleted once the task is complete. You can also see real-time data in the status bar to see which AI is currently active. We balance performance with a steadfast commitment to your privacy. * Real-time AI status bar - coming soon

slides.title: Essential Key
slides.body: Press once to capture your screen, long-press to record voice and ideas, and double-press to access Essential Space.

slides.title: Your to-do list sorted
slides.body: Speak aloud what's on your mind. Essential Space then intelligently generates a detailed to-do list and schedules specific time slots for each task.

slides.title: All thoughts organised
slides.body: Screen-shot or voice your favourite ideas and inspirations. Organise all your content in collections, or let Essential Space organise them for you.

slides.title: Never miss that, again
slides.body: Something interesting catch your eye? Open your camera and capture it with Essential Key. Essential Space transcribes and saves it as a reminder.

slides.title: All info, captured
slides.body: Essential Space recognises different speakers during your meetings and transcribes content. Allow AI to condense content into a meeting summary and pull together relevant to-do's.

slides.title: One search, every answer
slides.body: With the new Essential Search, everything is within reach. Instantly find contacts, content and important info, and get real-time answers, from weather updates to sports scores. To access Essential Search, swipe up from the bottom of your screen. * Essential Search is currently supported only in Australia, Brazil, the EEA, India, Turkey, the UK, and the US.

slides.title: Find everything
slides.body: Access your on-device data anytime, anywhere. Type your keywords, and find what you need, no internet required. Fast, simple, and always accessible.

slides.title: All questions answered
slides.body: Answer any question with contextual natural language searches. Quickly retrieve important information, or find all answers you need. Your ideas, realised instantly.

slides.title: The power of AI at your fingertips
slides.body: Explore more AI features, including Wallpaper Studio for captivating visuals, Essential News Widget for instant updates, and ChatGPT Integration for smart interactions. Let AI enrich your life.

slides.title: A new kind of experience
slides.body: NOS 4 delivers helpful tools, smarter multitasking, and intuitive commands - letting you focus on what matters and cut the noise.

slides.title: Design, refreshed
slides.body: NOS 4 refines every detail. Fonts, buttons, lists, and layouts feel cleaner, more intuitive, and unmistakably Nothing.

slides.title: Time, think twice
slides.body: A fresh take on time. Two new clock faces, designed with a bold, future-forward aesthetic. Sharper fonts. Refined visuals.

slides.title: Control tower, refined
slides.body: Quick Settings is cleaner and more coherent. Sharper icons, clearer titles, updated colors, and a sleeker media player. Quick Wi-Fi sharing makes connecting instant.

slides.title: Extra Dark
slides.body: Designed for comfort and low light. Extra Dark Mode deepens our signature aesthetic - cooler, smarter, and easier on the eyes with deeper blacks, sharper contrast, and lower power use.

slides.title: Enhanced multitasking
slides.body: Elevate your productivity with pop-up view. It lets you run two floating apps at once with effortless gestures. Swipe up to minimise, pull down to expand.

slides.title: Productivity, optimised
slides.body: Boost speed and save power. One tap analyses background apps and improves efficiency. See them at a glance and keep your device running at its peak.

slides.title: Live updated
slides.body: Real-time notifications keep you informed with no extra taps. Track deliveries and rides instantly, all within Nothing OS and Android 16.

slides.title: AI processing, tracked
slides.body: See which LLM is active with Essential Space, Search, or other AI features. The yellow icon gives real-time visibility of AI tools in your status bar. All interactions with AI services are recorded, giving a clear view of how large language models are used on your device. Check the AI Usage Dashboard in Settings for daily and weekly trends. See which models are most active and dive into the details with full visibility and control.

slides.title: Your digital canvas awaits
slides.body: Playground brings all creative possibilities across Nothing devices into one space. Explore, experiment, and share. Join thousands of creators and build something uniquely yours for the Nothing community. In Playground, discover, create, and share Essential Apps, Glyph Toys, Camera Presets, and EQ Profiles together with fellow creators. Join the movement and shape the future of Nothing.

slides.title: Rationally harmonious
slides.body: Aesthetics that cut through the noise. Materials that feel good. Phone (3) redefines style, blending superior craftsmanship and durability.

slides.title: Intentional aesthetics
slides.body: Phone (3) is a celebration of functional and intentional design. Every curve, material, and line serves a purpose, fusing Technical Warmth with striking simplicity. It’s style with substance, a celebration of form meeting function in the most intentional way.

slides.title: Slim symmetries
slides.body: Phone (3)'s screen bezel features a 1.87mm border, 18% slimmer than Phone (2). It frames the screen with an even width on all sides for a balanced and immersive view.

slides.title: True transparency
slides.body: A meticulously designed cutout allows a view through the back into the actual motherboard circuit, showcasing the beauty of industrial mechanics.

slides.title: IP68
slides.body: Ready for anything. From an accidental drop in the sink to sudden downpours, Phone (3) shrugs off water with full IP68 protection. Because life doesn’t wait for dry conditions.

slides.title: Premium materials
slides.body: High-grade Corning Gorilla Glass safeguards the front and back, while a precision-machined, anti-fingerprint aluminium frame exudes luxury and durability.

slides.title: Built to last
slides.body: 68 quality control protocols and over 95,000 tests. IP Rating Dust and Water Test Rated IP68 for dust and water resistance. Fluid Immersion Test Submerged in 150 cm of water for 30 Minutes. Atmospheric Ageing Test 85°C environment with 85% humidity for 21 days. Extreme Temperature Test Controlled temperature environment which fluctuates between -40°C and 75°C for 21 days. USB Durability Test 30,000 insertion + extraction cycles using a USB-C cable. Button Press Test 25,000 cycles of pressing each button.

slides.title: Designed for tomorrow
slides.body: Designed with sustainability in mind, Phone (3) incorporates 53 components that contain recycled materials, accounting for 17.61% of the total weight. Recycled materials 100% recycled tin is used on 9 circuit boards 80% recycled steel is used in 27 steel parts 100% recycled aluminum is used for the mid-frame, buttons, and SIM tray 100% recycled copper foil is used on the main board 30% recycled plastic is used in 17 plastic parts Packaging 100% plastic-free Manufacturing 100% renewable energy for final assembly process Carbon footprint 53.2 kg

slides.title: Four cameras, 50 million ideas
slides.body: Capture every moment in detail with the all-50MP camera. When the red light is on, it’s your time to create.

slides.title: Nothing Camera
slides.body: Intuitive controls and photographer-level features. Including quick record for instant video access, alongside burst shot modes, a zoom indicator, portrait effects and new watermarks.

slides.title: Designed to push the limits
slides.body: Phone (3) is powered by the Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 mobile platform. A powerful and efficient processor, for ultra performance. Overview: Up to 24 GB RAM Boost 8 all big cores up to 3.2 Ghz with 4nm process AI Engine LPDDR5X RAM + UFS 4.0 ROM 36% faster CPU processing* 88% graphics improved* 60% AI performance* *Compared to Nothing Phone (2) Snapdragon and Qualcomm branded products are products of Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. and/or its subsidiaries.

slides.title: Built for AI
slides.body: The Snapdragon 8s Gen 4’s processing speed is 125% faster than Phone (2), unlocking quicker, better, and more efficient camera performance. Imaging, elevated Leverages the Qualcomm 8 Elite-grade ISP for pro-level image processing, including real-time semantic segmentation, reduced noise, smoother motion and brighter HDR capture.

slides.title: Long lasting, fast charging
slides.body: Phone (3) features our most advanced and longest-lasting battery yet, charging from 1-50% in under 20 minutes. It is also compatible with 15W wireless charging and doubles as a 5W wireless charger, allowing you to power accessories like Nothing Ear on-the-go. 44% faster wired charging speed* 10% higher battery energy density* 17% higher battery capacity* *Compare to Nothing Phone (2)

slides.title: More pixels
slides.body: Stunningly sharp visuals with a resolution of 1260 x 2800, inky, vibrant AMOLED technology, with an impressive pixel density of 460 ppi. Enjoy Nothing's richest, most true-to-life visuals.

slides.title: More light
slides.body: Featuring a 6.67" flexible AMOLED display, delivering an incredible 4500 nits of brightness. 4500 nits +181.2% peak brightness* 460 ppi +16.7% pixel density* 1000 Hz +316% touch sampling rate* 6.67" 120Hz Flexible AMOLED display HDR10+ Certification 1.07 billion vivid colours 1,000,000:1 contrast ratio * Compare to Nothing Phone (2)

slides.title: Sounds right
slides.body: Phone (3) features a symmetrical speakers structure. With speakers on both sides of the frame, enjoy un-muffled clarity however you hold it.

slides.title: Spatial audio with head tracking
slides.body: Unlock spatial audio with head tracking when you pair Phone (3) with Nothing Headphone (1). The soundstage adjusts to your movements, creating an enveloping 360-degree audio field.

slides.body: Must-have extras for a complete Nothing phone experience Linear haptic motor: 14% larger than Phone (2) for more tactile vibration responses. Smart 5G: Reduces network latency by 15%. 360 antenna: Ring design around the phone to ensure no dead zones. Rapid cellular data recovery: Data stalling reduced by over 72% Gaming network boost: Reduces gaming network latency by 50% Game colour plus: Enhance colour display of game content for clearer details in dark areas eSIM enabled: Subscribe to a mobile plan from a network provider without the need for a physical SIM card.
